meta.description: Learn more about UAB TRANSGARANT GROUP, a transport and logistics company providing freight transport and forwarding services in Lithuania and across Europe.

hero.title: Logistics solutions for long-term partnerships
hero.intro: UAB TRANSGARANT GROUP is a transport and logistics company organising domestic and international cargo transport across Europe. We specialise in freight transport and forwarding.
hero.imageAlt: Cargo being prepared in a logistics warehouse

overview.title: Experience that helps find the right solution
overview.badgeAlt: Creditinfo rating “Strongest in Lithuania 2020–2026” – UAB “TRANSGARANT GROUP”
paragraphs: Our experience transporting cargo on domestic and international routes enables us to offer solutions tailored to each client’s needs. We use our own vehicles and a trusted partner network to organise every shipment.

We specialise in transporting small, partial and full loads by road. An extensive partner network across Europe allows us to plan routes flexibly and ensure safe and timely delivery of cargo to the recipient.
Our responsible approach is focused on long-term cooperation and dependable partnerships. We believe that quality services help our clients develop their businesses successfully.
overview.highlight: Our goal is safe and timely cargo delivery, clear communication and long-term cooperation.
